title: Put your hope where the world cannot reach
summary: Hope in the Lord lifts the heart beyond the world's reach. Return the heart to shelter before it hardens again.
takeaway: Return the heart to shelter before it hardens again.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: Hope in the Lord lifts the heart beyond the world's reach.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next anxious scan, lift the gaze and place your trust above the circumstance.

evidence.coreClaim: Hope in the Lord lifts the heart beyond the world's reach.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: let hope in the Lord outrank the world's reach.
